content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV unveiled multiple announcements, including a surprise reveal of the premiere date for Silo season 4.

Silo season 4 will debut in the summer of 2027 and will serve as the show's final season.

Silo season 3 is currently airing (watch it here), with new episodes releasing weekly until September 4.

However, at San Diego Comic-Con over the weekend, Apple not only shared updates on other sci-fi series but also delivered a surprise for fans of Silo.

Silo season 4 will premiere next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement post shared by Apple TV on platform X:

In the streaming era, new seasons of a series often arrive years apart — a pattern especially common for high-budget sci-fi productions like Silo.

Nevertheless, Apple has been actively accelerating the return of some of its shows through strategies such as advance greenlights. In the case of Silo, seasons 3 and 4 were developed simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

There are still six weeks of new episodes left in Silo, but once this season wraps up, audiences won't have to wait long for season 4.

How do you feel about Silo season 3 so far? Let us know in the comments section.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is priced at US$12.99, with discounts available when bundled through an Apple One subscription.
